edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

def read_feed(path):
    """Read an EU feed: a list of {date, account, amount} rows."""

Fixed both readers to read the declared `# format:` header and parse v1 localized amounts or v2 plain decimals correctly. Unsupported formats now raise an error instead of producing bad totals.

Added regression tests for EU/APAC v1 and v2 feeds and monthly report totals. All 10 tests pass, and EU October now reports `1774765.57 EUR`. Committed as `5969fcc`.

END OF REPORT
